```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6.5)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

gp <- function(p, tooltip = "text") {
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = tooltip) |>
    layout(hovermode = "closest", legend = list(font = list(size = 10))) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}

st <- jsonlite::fromJSON("capture_status.json")
have_curves <- file.exists("../capture/latest.parquet")
have_history <- file.exists("../capture/history.csv")
index <- if (file.exists("../capture/index.json"))
  jsonlite::fromJSON("../capture/index.json")
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)
```

```{r stale, results="asis"}
if (isTRUE(st$stale)) {
  cat('<div class="alert alert-warning"><strong>These data may be out of date.</strong><ul>',
      paste0("<li>", htmltools::htmlEscape(unlist(st$problems)), "</li>", collapse = ""),
      "</ul></div>")
}
```

What fraction of all synapses the proofread bodies capture, from the Aedes
synapse snapshot `r st$capture %||% "?"`
(`r st$capture_timestamp %||% "?"`). Checked
`r st$checked`. Companion [QC](index.html) and
[annotation](annotation.html) dashboards.

Bodies are ranked by tier, then by synapse count within each tier:
`r if (!is.null(index)) paste(sprintf("**%s**: %s", names(index$tiers), unlist(index$tiers)), collapse = "; ")`.
A connection is captured once both its bodies are (at the larger of their
ranks); fractions are of all synapses, including those on no body (root 0).
The thin navy line is the synapse count of each ranked body.

```{r curves, eval=have_curves}
# latest.parquet is only fetched along with index.json
cap <- arrow::read_parquet("../capture/latest.parquet")
tier_labels <- setNames(paste0(names(index$tiers), ": ", unlist(index$tiers)),
                        names(index$tiers))
sub <- sprintf("snapshot %s (%s)", st$capture, substr(st$capture_timestamp, 1, 10))
```

## Whole brain

```{r whole-brain, eval=have_curves}
aedes::aedes_plot_capture(
  select(filter(cap, .data$region == "all"), -"region"),
  tier_labels = tier_labels, subtitle = sub)
```

## Central brain and optic lobe

`r if (!is.null(index)) paste("OL:", index$regions$OL)`; CB: everything else.
Bodies are ranked by their synapses in each region.

```{r cb-ol, fig.height=10, eval=have_curves}
aedes::aedes_plot_capture(filter(cap, .data$region != "all"),
                          tier_labels = tier_labels, subtitle = sub)
```

## Capture at the end of each tier

The `Δ` columns are the change since the previous snapshot.

```{r tier-table, eval=have_history}
h <- readr::read_csv("../capture/history.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(timestamp = as.POSIXct(.data$timestamp, tz = "UTC")) |>
  arrange(.data$timestamp)
fr <- c("frac_pre", "frac_post", "frac_both")
h |>
  group_by(.data$region, .data$point) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(fr), ~ sprintf("%+.1f", 100 * (.x - lag(.x))),
                .names = "d_{.col}")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(.data$tag == last(.data$tag)) |>
  mutate(region = factor(.data$region, c("all", "CB", "OL")),
         across(all_of(fr), pct)) |>
  arrange(.data$region, .data$rank) |>
  select(region = "region", point = "point", bodies = "rank",
         pre = "frac_pre", `Δ pre` = "d_frac_pre",
         post = "frac_post", `Δ post` = "d_frac_post",
         connections = "frac_both", `Δ conn.` = "d_frac_both") |>
  knitr::kable(align = "llrrrrrrr", format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## Trend

Capture of connections (both sides) at the end of tiers A and B.

```{r trend, fig.height=4.5, eval=have_history}
tr <- h |>
  filter(.data$point %in% c("end of A", "end of B")) |>
  mutate(text = sprintf("%s %s %s<br>%s: %s of connections, %s bodies",
                        .data$tag, format(.data$timestamp, "%Y-%m-%d"),
                        .data$region, .data$point, pct(.data$frac_both),
                        format(.data$rank, big.mark = ",")))
gp(ggplot(tr, aes(.data$timestamp, .data$frac_both, colour = .data$region,
                  linetype = .data$point, group = interaction(.data$region, .data$point),
                  text = .data$text)) +
     geom_line() + geom_point(size = 1) +
     scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
     labs(x = NULL, y = "connections captured", colour = "region", linetype = NULL) +
     theme_minimal())
```
